tools.name: batch-send-bulk-email
tools.description: Send a batch of bulk emails (Mailtrap bulk-stream API) in one call. Shared fields go on `base`; per-recipient overrides go in `requests[]`. Each request must include at least one of `to`/`cc`/`bcc`.

tools.name: batch-send-sandbox-email
tools.description: Send a batch of emails in sandbox mode to a test inbox in one Mailtrap API call. Shared fields go on `base`; per-recipient overrides go in `requests[]`. Requires `sandbox_id` or the MAILTRAP_SANDBOX_ID env var.

tools.name: batch-send-transactional-email
tools.description: Send a batch of transactional emails in one Mailtrap API call. Shared fields go on `base`; per-recipient overrides go in `requests[]`. Each request must include `to`.

tools.name: bulk-update-permissions
tools.description: Bulk create, update, or destroy permissions for an account access. Existing (resource_type, resource_id) pairs are updated; new ones are created. Set `destroy: true` to remove.

tools.name: cancel-email-campaign
tools.description: Cancel a `scheduled` email campaign, returning it to `draft`; only `scheduled` campaigns can be cancelled.

tools.name: clean-sandbox-inbox
tools.description: Delete all messages from a sandbox inbox without deleting the inbox itself

tools.name: create-api-token
tools.description: Create a new API token. The response includes the secret `token` value — this is the **only time** the full token is returned, so store it immediately.

tools.name: create-company-info
tools.description: Set the company info of a sending domain, required for domain compliance verification.

tools.name: create-contact
tools.description: Create a new contact. Requires `email`; optionally accepts custom `fields`, `list_ids` to subscribe to, and `unsubscribed` to start in unsubscribed status.

tools.name: create-contact-event
tools.description: Record a contact event (by `name` + arbitrary `params`) against a contact ID or email. Used to trigger automations.

tools.name: create-contact-export
tools.description: Export contacts matching a set of AND-combined filters. Returns an export job; poll status with `get-contact-export` to retrieve the download URL.

tools.name: create-contact-field
tools.description: Create a new contact field definition. `merge_tag` must be unique and is used in template variables.

tools.name: create-contact-import
tools.description: Bulk import contacts. Returns an import job record; poll status via `get-contact-import`.

tools.name: create-contact-list
tools.description: Create a new contact list.

tools.name: create-email-campaign
tools.description: Create a new email campaign in the `draft` state; requires `name`, `domain_id`, `from_local_part`, and a `template_attributes.subject`.

tools.name: create-inbound-folder
tools.description: Create a new inbound folder.

tools.name: create-inbound-inbox
tools.description: Create a new inbound inbox in a folder. Omit `domain_id` for a Mailtrap-hosted inbox; pass it for a custom-domain (catch-all) inbox.

tools.name: create-sandbox-inbox
tools.description: Create a new sandbox test inbox within a project. Returns SMTP credentials for the new inbox.

tools.name: create-sandbox-project
tools.description: Create a new sandbox project to group test inboxes

tools.name: create-sending-domain
tools.description: Create a new sending domain

tools.name: create-sub-account
tools.description: Create a new sub-account under the organization. Requires `MAILTRAP_ORGANIZATION_ID` and sub-account management permissions.

tools.name: create-suppression
tools.description: Add an email address to the account's suppression list, so Mailtrap stops delivering to it.

tools.name: create-template
tools.description: Create a new email template

tools.name: create-tracking-opt-out
tools.description: Exclude an email address from open and click tracking for a sending domain.

tools.name: create-webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook. `webhook_type` may be `email_sending`, `audit_log`, or `inbound_receiving`; for `inbound_receiving`, `inbound_inbox_id` is optional (scopes the webhook to one inbox — omit to apply to all inboxes). The response includes a `signing_secret` for verifying webhook payload signatures — this secret is returned only on creation, so store it now.

tools.name: delete-api-token
tools.description: Permanently delete an API token by ID. The token can no longer authenticate after deletion.

tools.name: delete-contact
tools.description: Permanently delete a contact by ID or email. Returns the deleted contact record when available.

tools.name: delete-contact-field
tools.description: Permanently delete a contact field definition by ID.

tools.name: delete-contact-list
tools.description: Permanently delete a contact list by ID.

tools.name: delete-email-campaign
tools.description: Delete an email campaign by ID; only a campaign in the `draft` state can be deleted.

tools.name: delete-inbound-folder
tools.description: Permanently delete an inbound folder along with all of its inboxes.

tools.name: delete-inbound-inbox
tools.description: Permanently delete an inbound inbox.

tools.name: delete-inbound-message
tools.description: Permanently delete an inbound message.

tools.name: delete-inbound-thread
tools.description: Permanently delete an inbound thread.

tools.name: delete-sandbox-inbox
tools.description: Delete a sandbox inbox and all its messages

tools.name: delete-sandbox-message
tools.description: Delete a single sandbox message

tools.name: delete-sandbox-project
tools.description: Delete a sandbox project and all its inboxes

tools.name: delete-sending-domain
tools.description: Delete a sending domain

tools.name: delete-suppression
tools.description: Delete a suppression by ID. Mailtrap will resume delivery to this email unless it gets suppressed again.

tools.name: delete-template
tools.description: Delete an existing email template

tools.name: delete-tracking-opt-out
tools.description: Remove an email address from the tracking opt-out list, so open and click tracking applies to it again.

tools.name: delete-webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete a webhook by ID. Returns the deleted webhook record.

tools.name: enable-sandbox-email-address
tools.description: Enable the receive-by-email address for a sandbox

tools.name: forward-inbound-message
tools.description: Forward an inbound message to new recipients (at least one `to` is required). Sends a real email.

tools.name: forward-sandbox-message
tools.description: Forward a sandbox message to an email address (counts against your monthly forwarding quota)

tools.name: get-api-token
tools.description: Get an API token by ID. The secret token value is NOT returned here — only the metadata (name, last 4 digits, resources).

tools.name: get-billing-usage
tools.description: Get the current billing cycle usage for the account (sending and testing plans, limits, and current counts).

tools.name: get-company-info
tools.description: Get the company info of a sending domain, used for domain compliance verification.

tools.name: get-contact
tools.description: Get a contact by ID or email address. Returns the full contact record including list memberships, status, and custom fields.

tools.name: get-email-campaign-stats
tools.description: Get aggregated performance statistics for an email campaign; optionally narrow the window with `start_date`/`end_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

tools.name: get-email-log-message
tools.description: Get a single email log message by ID (UUID) to inspect delivery status and event history.

tools.name: get-inbound-folder
tools.description: Get a single inbound folder by ID.

tools.name: get-inbound-inbox
tools.description: Get a single inbound inbox by ID.

tools.name: get-inbound-message
tools.description: Get a single inbound message with its full body and attachment download URLs.

tools.name: get-inbound-thread
tools.description: Get a single inbound thread with its messages embedded (oldest first).

tools.name: get-permission-resources
tools.description: Get all resources (inboxes, projects, domains, billing, account) to which the API token has admin access, nested by hierarchy.

tools.name: get-sandbox-attachment
tools.description: Get the metadata and download URL for a single sandbox attachment.

tools.name: get-sandbox-inbox
tools.description: Get sandbox inbox details including SMTP credentials, email counts, and status

tools.name: get-sandbox-message-eml
tools.description: Get a sandbox message as an EML file payload.

tools.name: get-sandbox-message-headers
tools.description: Get the parsed mail headers for a sandbox message.

tools.name: get-sandbox-message-html
tools.description: Get the rendered HTML body of a sandbox message.

tools.name: get-sandbox-message-html-analysis
tools.description: Get HTML analysis for a sandbox message (client compatibility, problematic elements).

tools.description: Get the unrendered HTML source of a sandbox message.

tools.description: Get the raw message (MIME-formatted) for a sandbox message.

tools.name: get-sandbox-message-spam-score
tools.description: Get the SpamAssassin spam report for a sandbox message (score, rules, report).

tools.name: get-sandbox-message-text
tools.description: Get the plain-text body of a sandbox message.

tools.name: get-sandbox-messages
tools.description: Get list of messages from the sandbox test inbox

tools.name: get-sandbox-project
tools.description: Get a sandbox project by ID, including its inboxes and email counts

tools.name: get-sending-domain
tools.description: Get a sending domain by ID and its verification status. Optionally include DNS setup instructions via include_setup_instructions.

tools.name: get-sending-stats
tools.description: Get email sending statistics (delivery, bounce, open, click, spam rates) for a date range. Optionally break down by domain, category, email service provider, or date.

tools.name: get-template
tools.description: Get a single email template by ID, including subject, category, and HTML/text body.

tools.name: get-webhook
tools.description: Get a single webhook by ID.

tools.name: list-account-accesses
tools.description: List account accesses (users, invites, API tokens) for the account. Optionally scope by domain UUIDs, inbox IDs, or project IDs. Requires account admin/owner permissions.

tools.name: list-accounts
tools.description: List Mailtrap accounts accessible to the API token, with each account's access levels.

tools.name: list-api-tokens
tools.description: List all API tokens for the account.

tools.name: list-contact-fields
tools.description: List all contact field definitions for the account.

tools.name: list-contact-lists
tools.description: List all contact lists for the account. Optionally filter by name with `search` (case-insensitive match).

tools.name: list-email-campaigns
tools.description: List the account's email campaigns, newest first, with page-token pagination (`token`, `per_page`). Optionally filter by name with `search`.

tools.description: List all webhooks for the account.

tools.description: Remove an account access by ID. For User specifiers this revokes permissions; for Invite or ApiToken specifiers it removes the specifier itself. Requires admin/owner.

tools.name: reply-all-to-inbound-message
tools.description: Reply to an inbound message and copy the original's other recipients. Sends a real email.

tools.name: reply-to-inbound-message
tools.description: Reply to an inbound message (sends to the original sender). Sends a real email.
